name: ART Care Patient List
description: A cumulative list of patients who are enrolled into care at the clinic to the specified dates

config.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id
FROM encounter e
         INNER JOIN person p
                    ON p.person_id = e.patient_id
         INNER JOIN encounter_type et
                    ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type
         INNER JOIN obs o
                    ON o.person_id = e.patient_id
WHERE et.uuid in  ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f','c11774c1-3b4a-4bdb-a847-6060895e006d','8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')
  AND e.voided = 0
  AND p.dead = 0
  AND o.concept_id in  (90315,99064,99061,99268,99126,99269)
  AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate;

SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id
FROM encounter e
         INNER JOIN person p
                    ON p.person_id = e.patient_id
         INNER JOIN encounter_type et
                    ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type
         INNER JOIN obs o
                    ON o.person_id = e.patient_id
WHERE et.uuid in  ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f','c11774c1-3b4a-4bdb-a847-6060895e006d','8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')
  AND e.voided = 0
  AND p.dead = 0
  AND o.concept_id in  (90315,99064,99061,99268,99126,99269)
  AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate;

SELECT obs_datetime
FROM obs
WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '73312fee-c321-11e8-a355-529269fb1459')
  AND person_id = :patientId
  AND voided = 0
ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value_datetime
FROM obs
WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'ab505422-26d9-41f1-a079-c3d222000440')
  AND person_id = :patientId
  AND obs_datetime <= :endDate
  AND voided = 0
ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'dd2b0b4d-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115') AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, (SELECT value_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'ab505422-26d9-41f1-a079-c3d222000440') AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1), :endDate)

SELECT value_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'dcac04cf-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115') AND person_id = :patientId AND value_datetime >= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT regimen
FROM (
         SELECT
             o.value_text AS regimen,
             o.obs_datetime
         FROM obs o
                  INNER JOIN concept c
                             ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id
         WHERE c.uuid = '97c48198-3cf7-4892-a3e6-d61fb1125882'
           AND o.person_id = :patientId
           AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate
           AND o.voided = 0
           AND o.value_text IS NOT NULL

         UNION ALL
         SELECT
             cn.name AS regimen,
             o.obs_datetime
         FROM obs o
                  INNER JOIN concept c
                             ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id
                  INNER JOIN concept_name cn
                             ON cn.concept_id = o.value_coded
         WHERE c.uuid = 'dd2b0b4d-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115'
           AND o.person_id = :patientId
           AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate
           AND o.voided = 0
           AND cn.voided = 0
           AND cn.locale = 'en'
           AND cn.locale_preferred = 1
     ) regimen_results
WHERE regimen IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(regimen) <> ''
ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT obs_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'dd2b0b4d-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115') AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT baseline_regimen
FROM (
         SELECT
             cn.name AS baseline_regimen,
             o.obs_datetime
         FROM obs o
                  INNER JOIN concept c
                             ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id
                  INNER JOIN concept_name cn
                             ON cn.concept_id = o.value_coded
         WHERE c.uuid = 'c3332e8d-2548-4ad6-931d-6855692694a3'
           AND o.person_id = :patientId
           AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate
           AND o.voided = 0
           AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL
           AND cn.locale = 'en'
           AND cn.locale_preferred = 1
           AND cn.voided = 0

         UNION ALL

         SELECT
             o.value_text AS baseline_regimen,
             o.obs_datetime
         FROM obs o
                  INNER JOIN concept c
                             ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id
         WHERE c.uuid = 'cc3d64df-61a5-4c5a-a755-6e95d6ef3295'
           AND o.person_id = :patientId
           AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate
           AND o.voided = 0
           AND o.value_text IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(o.value_text) <> ''
     ) baseline_results
WHERE baseline_regimen IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(baseline_regimen) <> ''
ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT obs_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'c3332e8d-2548-4ad6-931d-6855692694a3') AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT value_numeric
FROM obs
WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'c17bd9df-23e6-4e65-ba42-eb6d9250ca3f')
  AND person_id = :patientId
  AND voided = 0
ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'c17bd9df-23e6-4e65-ba42-eb6d9250ca3f') AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'dcbcba2c-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime BETWEEN DATE_SUB((SELECT value_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'ab505422-26d9-41f1-a079-c3d222000440') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND DATE_ADD((SELECT value_datetime FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'ab505422-26d9-41f1-a079-c3d222000440') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1
